description: Chat intents (Homemind's intents.ts). `contexts`: what a reply is checked against, per member (from their view, at `now`, with the family's stores). `validations`: a model reply and validateIntent's result (the value built from known fields only, or the problems, which go back to the model word for word). `extractions`: validateExtraction (quotes not in a text source are dropped). `parse`: parseReply; `json` is false when the text is not JSON at all. `dates`: Date.parse of ISO datetimes, null when JavaScript refuses one; a day past the end of the month rolls over. `prompts`: intentPrompt, byte for byte (system and user), for the inputs given; `preferences` are the family's, passed in. `extractionPrompts`: extractionPrompt for text. `runs`: runValidated with a scripted model (one retry that says what was wrong; no retry after auth or not_configured), with the follow-up turns each call carried. The roster has no age (HOPA's v1 board has none). Generated; do not edit by hand.
